evals.name: create-draft
evals.prompt: Create the PR for my current branch. Set a good title and description, and make the review path clear for whoever picks it up.
evals.expected_output: Pushes the fixture branch if needed, creates a draft PR, and writes an accurate thematic title, summary, and review guide.

evals.name: update-existing
evals.prompt: Refresh the existing PR's title and body from what the branch actually does now. Keep the issue link, but replace the stale implementation notes with a concise feature-level review guide.
evals.expected_output: Updates rather than recreates the PR, preserves the issue link, removes stale notes, and groups the body by behavior.

evals.name: cross-cutting-review
evals.prompt: Update this PR's title and description. The change crosses the command entry point, persistence, and cleanup behavior; describe the user-facing result and give reviewers a useful order to review it without dumping a list of files.
evals.expected_output: Produces a concise outcome-oriented title and a review guide ordered by runtime flow rather than by changed file.

evals.name: repository-template
evals.prompt: Create the draft PR for this branch. The repository has a pull-request template under `.github`; follow it exactly, keep the description useful to reviewers, and do not publish metadata that fails its title or body requirements.
evals.expected_output: Treats the repository template as authoritative, preserves its exact required structure, fills each requested section, validates the title and body, and only then creates the draft PR.
